title: 第6章 投资谈成
content_zh:
陆穿现在可是天才导演，不缺投资。

    当他决定要拍什么之后，华谊立马掏钱。

    当听说他要翻拍好莱坞电影的时候，掏钱的动作更麻溜了。

    几人约的地方在国贸附近一家极其私密的中餐厅包厢里。

    谷川到的时候，陆穿已经坐在那儿了，旁边还坐着一个穿着西装，气质儒雅的中年男人。

    “谷川，来晚了啊！”陆穿笑着招手，随即指了指旁边的男人。

    “介绍一下，这位是华谊兄弟的王忠磊，王总。”

    陆穿又对王忠磊介绍谷川：“这是谷川，我朋友，从小在美国长大，在好莱坞有人脉。”

    谷川伸出手：“王总好，久仰大名。”

    王忠磊站起身，笑着握了握谷川的手，语气温和：“客气客气了，我也常听陆穿提起你，年纪轻轻，能拿到好莱坞大片的翻拍版权，了不得啊。”

    三人落座，寒暄几句后，谷川直接把一沓厚厚的英文文件拍在了桌子上。

    “王总，东西我都带来了。《女巫布莱克》的大陆独家翻拍权，三年有效期。这可是好莱坞那边正火的概念，伪纪录片，成本极低，票房爆炸。”谷川开门见山。

    “我和穿哥商量过了，他来执导，我来做制片人，剧本已经搞定，就差投资到账了。”

    王忠磊拿起文件翻了翻，虽然看不懂具体的法律条款，但那份全英文的授权书看着确实唬人。

    他放下文件，端起茶杯抿了一口，目光转向陆穿：“陆导，这片子你研究过吗？这种伪纪录片的形式，在国内可是从来没有先例。观众能不能接受，是个大问题啊。”

    谷川替他开口道：“王总，正因为没有先例，才是机会。

    这种手持摄影，第一视角的沉浸式体验，带来的恐惧感和真实感是传统电影给不了的。

    而且，穿哥当导演，拍什么都有人看。”

    谷川简单的恭维了一下。

    陆穿已经成功过一次了，下一次成功的概率很大，虽然也不知道《寻枪》成功的最大功臣是谁。

    王忠磊点了点头，手指轻轻敲击着桌面：“说得有道理，可这种电影，投资要八百万？”

    这剧本一看就是小制作啊。

    谷川冲陆穿眨了眨眼，随即对王忠磊笑道：“王总，账不能这么算。我们要做的不是小打小闹，是要冲着国际市场去的。

    后期音效、还有去国外电影节的宣发，哪样不要钱？

    再说了，这八百万里，我和穿哥可没算自己的片酬，全是投在制作上的。”

    是的，谷川和陆穿都不准备要钱。
content_en:
Lu Chuan is now a talented director and has no shortage of investment.

    After he decided what he wanted to shoot, Huayi immediately paid for it.

    When I heard that he was going to remake a Hollywood movie, it became even more difficult to pay for it.

    The meeting place for several people was in a private box of an extremely private Chinese restaurant near Guomao.

    When Tanichuan arrived, Lu Chuan was already sitting there, and sitting next to him was an elegant middle-aged man in a suit.

    "Tani Chuan, you're late!" Lu Chuan smiled and waved, then pointed at the man next to him.

    "Let me introduce, this is Wang Zhonglei from Huayi Brothers, Mr. Wang."

    Lu Chuan then introduced Tanichuan to Wang Zhonglei: "This is Tanichuan, my friend. He grew up in the United States and has connections in Hollywood."

    Tanichuan stretched out his hand: "Hello, Mr. Wang, I have long admired your name."

    Wang Zhonglei stood up, smiled and shook Tan Chuan's hand, with a gentle tone: "You're welcome, I often hear Lu Chuan mention you. It's amazing that you can get the remake rights of a Hollywood blockbuster at such a young age."

    The three of them sat down, and after exchanging a few words, Tanichuan slapped a thick stack of English documents on the table.

    "Mr. Wang, I have brought everything. The exclusive rights to remake "Blake" in mainland China, valid for three years. This is a popular concept in Hollywood, a pseudo-documentary, extremely low cost, and a box office explosion." Tanichuan got straight to the point.

    "I have discussed it with Brother Chuan. He will direct and I will be the producer. The script has been finalized, and the only thing left is to get the investment."

    Wang Zhonglei picked up the document and flipped through it. Although he couldn't understand the specific legal terms, the authorization letter, which was all in English, looked really scary.

    He put down the document, took a sip from the tea cup, and turned to Lu Chuan: "Director Lu, have you studied this film? There has never been any precedent for this kind of pseudo-documentary in China. Whether the audience can accept it or not is a big question."

    Tanichuan spoke for him: "Mr. Wang, precisely because there is no precedent, there is an opportunity.

    This kind of handheld photography and first-person perspective immersive experience brings a sense of fear and reality that traditional movies cannot provide.

    Moreover, as Brother Chuan is the director, there will be people watching everything he shoots. "

    Tanichuan gave a simple compliment.

    Lu Chuan has already succeeded once, and the probability of success next time is very high, although I don't know who is the biggest contributor to the success of "Looking for a Gun".

    Wang Zhonglei nodded and tapped his fingers on the table: "That makes sense, but does this kind of movie require an investment of eight million?"

    At first glance, this script looks like a small production.

    Tan Chuan blinked at Lu Chuan, then smiled at Wang Zhonglei and said: "Mr. Wang, you can't settle the accounts like this. What we have to do is not to make a small fuss, but to go to the international market.

    Post-production sound effects and promotion at foreign film festivals, which are free of charge?

    Besides, Brother Chuan and I did not count our own remuneration for these eight million dollars, all of which were invested in production. "

    Yes, neither Tanichuan nor Lu Chuan was prepared to ask for money.
